raw_recipe.headline: Slow Cooker Cranberry Chicken
raw_recipe.description: This is a delicious and easy way to prepare chicken breasts using a slow cooker.

review.reviewBody: I have made this with pork chops instead of chicken and it comes out great. You could also use a pork loin roast. When I first saw the recipe, the ingredients just didn't sound like they would go together, but I was intrigued. The concoction comes out tasting like a very mild barbecue sauce. Don't be afraid to try it! It is so nice to find a recipe that uses so few ingredients and ones that I usually have on hand.

I made this last night for Christmas Eve. I used a whole chicken, 1 can cranberry & about 2 cups fresh cranberries, 1 package onion soup & a little water. I left out the Catalina. It was DELISH and a huge hit! Using the fresh berries eliminated the problem other reviews had with berries (sauce) being too mushy & not staying whole. It's a festive, easy and yummy dish.

I have been using this recipe for about 25 years. It makes enough sauce for 10 chicken legs seperated. I also use French salad dressing and add a tin of mandarin oranges undrained. After putting the chicken in the crockpot or an oven dish (350 for 1-1/2 hours) I SPRINKLE THE CHICKEN GENEROUSLY WITH CURRY POWDER AND GARDLIC POWDER, plus some pepper, then add the sauce mixture. I turns out great over rice or pasta. I have to say that it took me a long time to try this dish because of the unusual ingredients but when I did try it, it became a "keeper".

I made this but prepped and froze 6 more servings for later. I mixed the 8oz Catalina dressing, 15oz whole cranberry sauce, and packet of onion soup mix. Placed 2 skinless, boneless chicken breasts (1 whole, split) in a freezer bag and poured about 1 cup of the sauce mixture over the chicken and froze. The sauce was enough to make 8 servings. I thaw and place in baking pan. Pre heat oven to 350 degrees and bake 45 minutes. Add a pan of roasted veggies and you have a wonderful meal.

Very quick and easy recipe to prepare.

Ladled some of the sauce (after removing chicken) strained it, and added it to a saucepan, with a teaspoon of melted butter and a teaspoon of flour combined. Nice gravy over mashed potatoes and green beans.

i used French dressing instead of Catalina. It's a bit more savory. This is a fabulous recipe! Actually have not done it in the slow cooker - usually use a 9x13 pan, mix all ingredients in the pan, then place chicken in the mixture, spooning the sauce over the chicken pieces. Into the oven at 350° for about 50 minutes. Serve over rice. YUM!

In the slow cooker, the recipe does not work as written; way too much liquid and chicken comes out dry and stringy if using skinless pieces. To make this work, as written, bake in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit until chicken is done. I also cook for a diabetic, so I use sugar-free dressing, fresh/frozen cranberries instead of sugary cranberry sauce, and non-caloric sweetener (I use swerve) to taste. For crockpot, use half the dressing and cook for the minimum time it takes to cook the chicken through (varies by cut and slow cooker model). Still not as good as in the oven, but sometimes it’s what you have to do).

I made with 2 thick, bone-in pork chops. Followed what others said and used only 1 cup of the salad dressing. Added juice of 1 mandarin orange, large handful of frozen cranberries and a tiny bit of ground red pepper flakes to balance off sweetness and it was perfect. Also added a cornstarch slurry to thicken sauce (or it would have been a watery mess). Will add more frozen/fresh cranberries next time for sure.

Based on the reviews I made a few adjustments, while sticking with the main recipe. I used 4 large chicken breasts and cut them in half, (1) can of cranberry sauce + 2 cups of fresh cranberries, last 1 packet of dry onion soup mix with 2/3 water. With a wisk mix together the onion mix and cranberry sauce then pour over chicken. adding the whole cranberries on top. I cooked in the slow cooker for 4 hours on low heat (or until cooked through). Super easy prep!

Half way through the cooking time I added a cup and a half of long grain rice and let it cool in the broth. Yum. Thinking that the next time I make it I'll add some cut up green peppers and onions and possibly pineapple making a sweet and sour dish. Will update when I do.

Made several changes that really turned out well, but plan on extra time and ingredients. Instead of onion soup mix, I sweated onion, shallot, and garlic. Being summer, I pitted and halved some fresh sweet red cherries and added about them about half way through cooking. Tossed in some raisins and a splash of balsamic vinegar. Will definitely make again. Next time, instead of cherries, I’m going to try crushed pineapple.
Sauce was thinner then in the picture and I only used 1/2 of the Catalina salad dressing
I made it today. It was delicious.
My new recipe for Thanksgiving. Perfect for 2 people.

This is a delicious and easy recipe. The only thing I would change is maybe using half of the bottle of dressing as there is so much liquid at the end. But then that would make it great over mashed potatoes! Okay it looks like I need to make this again. Thank you for a great and easy chicken recipe!
I have made this several times. It is SO GOOD!!! I never would think that the combo of favors would go together. This is wonderful over rice. The sauce is yummy.
So easy and flavorful. Made it several times and we all love it !

When I was putting it together I was thinking about what can I serve in case this is a flop. The ingredients were so strange. But everyone loved it. I used 1/2 bottle French dressing instead of 1bottle of Catalina. Very tasty. A nice surprise.
It's not a bad recipe. Curiously, it is absolutely identical to the recipe on the KRAFT website.

5 star easy , but sauce is greasy! Had to lay paper towels on top to absorb the grease! Is that from the dressing. Made twice. I prefer French to Catalina. ( too sweet) I think the amount of dressing could be cut 25-50% but the sauce is tasty.
